title: Customer Transition Assistant: SDK warnings, auto-migration prompts & pin rollover for legacy model checkpoints
creator: Priya Malhotra
description:
Goal: Build a customer-facing 'Transition Assistant' and internal guardrails to handle deprecation of older model checkpoints without breaking pinned production workloads. The assistant will combine: (1) automated notice cadence (in-console + email), (2) SDK-level warning flags and optional blocking behavior for clients using deprecated model versions, and (3) a safe pin-rollover workflow that recommends replacements, estimates latency/cost delta, and provides one-click migration scripts for common SDKs.

Scope: Hosted API and Dedicated customers for model variants that we plan to phase out (legacy checkpoints or obsolete quantization formats). Private deployments get the notice templates and migration docs but auto-migration scripts are opt-in.

Why: Customers frequently pin model versions but need proactive, low-friction help to move to supported variants. Current deprecation notices are manual and inconsistent; this ticket standardizes cadence and adds technical safeguards to avoid accidental silent upgrades or runtime breaks.

High-level components:
- Notice generator: schedules and sends 90/60/30/14/7/1-day notices, with in-console alert banners and email templates. Notices link to a per-model migration playbook.
- SDK changes: introduce a deprecation header/warning in SDK responses, a client-side log/warn flag, and an opt-in 'auto-migrate' flag that will automatically switch non-pinned requests if customer approves.
- Pin-rollover API: an admin endpoint to propose replacements, run a dry-run with perf/cost estimates, and apply changes with canary rollout semantics.
- Migration assistant UI: quick comparison (latency, tokens, estimated monthly spend delta) and one-click migration for Node/Python SDKs and curl.
- Telemetry & SLOs: track percent of pinned vs migrated instances, migration failure rates, rollback rates, and customer satisfaction survey after migration.

Deliverables: standard notice cadence, email + console templates, SDK PRs (node & python), migration-assistant UI mock, pin-rollover backend API design, telemetry events, runbook for support teams.

Telemetry dashboards showing migration adoption, rollback rates, and notice open/click metrics

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Silent break for pinned customers if auto-migration is applied without consent — Mitigation: default is no auto-migrate; explicit admin approval and canary rollout required
Risk: Migration causes slight quality regressions for edge prompts — Mitigation: require a prompt-set regression check in dry-run before allowing one-click migration
Risk: Telemetry incomplete for Private deployments — Mitigation: provide offline migration report templates and customer-run CLI dry-run tool
customer_communication_samples: Subject: Action required: migration path available for your pinned model version

If you'd like us to run a migration dry-run for your request patterns, reply to this message or use the console 'Run migration dry-run' button.
